question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ above. Which of the following represents the corresponding bilinear form ${x}^{T}\,Ay$ in terms of the components of $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]?$
question.worked_solution:
**Method 1**

Each entry ${a}_{ij}$ of $A$ corresponds to the term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ay & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+1{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

**Method 2**

To write down a bilinear form in terms of vector components, we compute the following expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ay & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2{y}_{1}+3{y}_{2} \\ {y}_{1}+2{y}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={x}_{1}(2{y}_{1}+3{y}_{2})+{x}_{2}({y}_{1}+2{y}_{2}) \\  & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$
